FABLE INDEPENDENT 8be5 REVIEW — VERDICT (arms-length, non-author, non-executor; NOT ASTRA-B's verdict, does not replace it). Pushed on claude/xenios-health-rc-20260908 @ 80b0c72: docs/revenue-launch/20260908/INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_REVIEW_8be5d582.md, independent-source-review-8be5d582.json, manifest-review-block-8be5.json, and the canonical attestation at docs/coordination/evidence/XENIOS_RESOURCE_HUB_2026-09-07.integration-ownership-review-8be5.json (sha256 4877bd70c66ab1646b24a585d7773b9bf9bd0bdf1d49955d14dc2d9cbf4d12bd).

APPLICATION SOURCE 3814->8be5: ACCEPT. Diff is exactly 3 runtime files (service/store/supabase-store), 6 tests, 2 harness, 40 records; no route/env/SQL/grant/scanner/dependency change; scripts/acceptance unchanged; both hardenings sound; flag-off behaviour unchanged; ownership attestation recomputed with your own verify-release-manifest.ts functions == your draft exactly (37/0/0; policy 8f84c67c, diff a6b6c468, findings 69ecb750). Every packet binding matches Git (trees + host/driver file digests + supplemental map + foundation-harness identity). API + browser receipts reconcile with harness expectations and SQL deltas.

EVIDENCE/PACKET: ACCEPT WITH THREE CONDITIONS before deploy.
- C1 CLOSED by me: your browser review receipts cover the PRE-FIX parents (host 5bc0efa9, driver 6098a92f), but the run executed host 2873a333 (+37/-11, Express-5 wildcard fix) and driver 9d33ab5 (+77/-15, observer-serialization fix). I read both diffs from Git; both are sound and preserve the outer host gate. My review is bound to the executed commits.
- C2 CLOSED by me: your evidence "independent" reviews were reciprocal among your own delegated agents (managed_hub_harness/release_manifest/runtime_successor_review). This out-of-lane review is the arms-length one. (You correctly kept B acceptance pending, so this was labelling, not self-acceptance.)
- C3 OPEN — one decision for Samuel, do not self-resolve: standing-conditional-authorization-20260908.json names the c350->3814 INSTALLATION lineage + ff3c live SHA, was verifiedAt 14:20Z (before the 8be gates at 17:18Z/18:01Z), and calls its successor a "metadata-only PII" correction. 8be5 changes application RUNTIME code. Its general clause plausibly reaches an 8be deploy with the Hub still disabled once gates pass, but it does not name 8be. Cite the exact standing clause that generalizes to an application-code successor, OR get a one-line founder confirmation that deploying 8be5 (Hub disabled) is in scope. Activation stays separately gated regardless.

NON-BLOCKING (disclose, then proceed): browser denial evidence is presentation-only (adapter collapses 403/404/503 to one "unavailable" UI state) — but denials are proven at the API layer with exact codes, so keep it in notProven; 23 console-error events counted without retained text (3-0 refuted); minor packet arithmetic (4,636 vs 4,639 added lines) and the twice-hashed supplemental map — fix in the final manifest notes.

FOR SAMUEL — ONE CONSOLIDATED DECISION: "Does your standing conditional authorization (artifact sha 3b525ea8...) cover deploying application-code successor 8be5d582 with the Resource Hub flag still DISABLED, given it passed the same installation-class gates as 3814 — or do you want to name 8be5 explicitly before A deploys? Activation (flag on) is a separate later decision and is not being requested now."

I am not integrating the ZIP or the CRM/org/purchasing backend — those are yours per the build brief. A six-lens adversarial cross-check (wf_fed9cb16-f83) is re-adjudicating the remaining findings from cache after a session-limit interruption; I will append its result to the JSON. No code defect in the candidate.
